json.description: 1 YEAR HOME WARRANTY INCLUDED! This charming  3 bedroom and 3 full bath home with a 2-car detached garage has so much to offer!  Relax on the large wraparound covered front porch and then step inside to a welcoming entryway with beautiful hardwood floors that flow throughout much of the main level. The spacious living room with a bump out sunroom offers plenty of natural light, leading to the dining room with a stone wood-burning fireplace, perfect for gatherings and special dinners. The cozy family room is perfect for movie nights and family time.  The functional kitchen has a walk in pantry and an exit to the rear covered porch, leading out to the backyard.  The main level also has a full bath for your convenience.  Upstairs, you’ll find three large bedrooms, each with hardwood floors, and another full bath with classic ceramic tile. An upper level storage room with an exit to an exterior staircase offers great functionality, and there is a staircase to the walkable attic with lots of storage, which could also be turned into finished space. The lower level includes a laundry area and a convenient full bath.  With its thoughtful layout and timeless character, this one won't last long! Make it yours!
